svg.aria-label: Animation: windows tile in an alternating split; a sixth window floats; resizing; dropping a floating window on a title bar tiles it.
svg.text: A new window goes to the end. Your master never moves.
Each one takes half of what's left, alternating direction
The order never changes on its own
Up to 5 tiles per screen (you can change that)
The 6th window floats instead of squeezing the rest
Drag any edge to resize · Meta+Ctrl+L / H
Floating windows move freely and never snap
Drop one on a tile's title bar to put it into the tiling
Meta+Ctrl+0 resets sizes · Meta+Shift+F floats or tiles a window
